name: Trailblazer
body:
You know how to leave a path for your less wilderness-savvy companions.

Prerequisite(s): Woodland stride class feature, Wisdom 13+

Benefit(s): When using your woodland stride ability to move through the undergrowth, you may leave a trail that a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom bonus (selected when you start leaving a trail) can follow within 1 minute. As long as they remain on your trail, the selected creatures may also move at normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment from the undergrowth.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
